summary: E2: a second job in .github/workflows/verify.yml that builds the Rust GDExtension on Linux, runs the seventeen headless GDScript suites through tools/verify-godot.sh, and fails loudly if the mock fallback was taken instead of the real bridge

coordination.notes: Adds a job beside the existing rust-and-content job; that job is left byte-identical. game/**, godot-rust/**, content/**, tools/** and docs/** are read-only here: game/** is inside backend-p0-unify-expedition-spines and the port-town work, tools/** belongs to E3, and docs/SHIP_PLAN.md is not a worktree editing surface (SHIP_PLAN section 9). The mock-versus-real-bridge proof is therefore made entirely from the workflow, out of markers the existing .gd files already print, with no edit to any test helper.
